description: Documenso /sign/:token: link gating, access auth, PDF with assigned fields, signature pad, rejection, completion, terminal pages.
summary: A recipient who loses signal while signing gets a red "Error" toast that never says why, and nothing tells them the connection is the problem. Of the 36 states this page needs, 1 has no design and 7 are half-built, mostly on paths a first-time recipient on a phone will hit. Three fixes take the score from 45 to 76.
